title: How ERC-4626 Tokenized Vault Standard Works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Deposit
        A[User deposits assets] --> B["shares = assets * totalSupply / totalAssets"]
        B --> C[Vault mints shares to user]
    end
    subgraph Accounting
        D["totalAssets = balanceOf(vault)"]
        E[totalSupply tracks all shares]
    end
    D --> B
    C --> E
    subgraph Withdraw
        F[User redeems shares] --> G["assets = shares * totalAssets / totalSupply"]
        G --> H[Vault returns underlying]
    end
    E --> G

title: First-Depositor Donation Inflation Attack
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A["Fresh vault: totalSupply = 0"] --> B[Attacker deposits 1 wei]
    B --> C["Mints 1 wei share = 100% supply"]
    C --> D[Donate large amount via transfer]
    D --> E["totalAssets inflated, supply unchanged"]
    E --> F[Front-run honest victim deposit]
    F --> G["shares = deposit / totalAssets floors to 0"]
    G --> H[Victim receives 0 shares]
    H --> I[Attacker redeems 1 wei share]
    I --> J[Steals donation plus victim deposit]

title: Defenses Against Vault Inflation
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[New vault deployment] --> B{Choose mitigations}
    B --> C[Virtual shares and decimal offset]
    B --> D[Seed dead shares on deploy]
    B --> E[Enforce minimum first deposit]
    B --> F[Internal asset accounting]
    C --> G["Virtual supply makes inflation costly"]
    D --> H["Lock initial shares to address 0"]
    E --> I["Revert when sharesMinted == 0"]
    F --> J["Ignore direct transfer donations"]
    G --> K[Rounding favors vault]
    H --> K
    I --> K
    J --> K
    K --> L[Attack becomes uneconomic]
